outcome: neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs) at 3 years of age
cohort: Children (n = 71,682) participating in the Japan Environment and Children's Study.
finding: Total pre-/perinatal reduced optimality scores were positively associated with 1-month developmental concerns and 3-year NDDs, with higher scores linked to an increased risk of both outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as an individual risk factor for 3-year NDDs.
